neighbours.label: 'Not' or 'Simply' opening a new clause or sentence (Not only..., not everyone..., Simply because...)
fire: The flu is common in winter. Not only that, but it spreads quickly.
Many praised the plan. On the other hand, not everyone agreed with it.
The tests were run twice. Simply because a result repeats does not make it true.
Stretching helps recovery. Simply add ten minutes to the end of each session.
They hoped silence would help. But not talking about it rarely works.
The company grew fast. Not all of its stores were profitable, though.
The rule was ignored. Not enforcing it sent a clear message to staff.
Cooking is easy here. Simply mix the flour and water in a bowl.
quiet: The flu is common in winter, and it spreads very quickly too.
Many praised the plan, although several people disagreed with it.
The tests were run twice, and both runs gave the same result.
Stretching helps recovery, so add ten minutes to each session.
They hoped silence would help, but it rarely works in practice.
The company grew fast, and most of its stores were profitable.
The rule was ignored, which sent a clear message to the staff.
Cooking is easy here: mix the flour and water in a bowl.

notes: card: ' Not', ' not', ' Simply' at clause starts.
